question: Can the existing exact macro expert provider run synchronously on gfx1201 fast enough to justify a tiled gfx1151-core/gfx1201-expert pipeline?
decision: Do not integrate the synchronous secondary provider. Its serialized host-to-gfx1201 delivery implementation dominates before useful expert compute; this run does not close a future batched asynchronous provider.

build.code_object_gate: PASS: libggml-hip contains both gfx1151 and gfx1201 bundles

hardware.candidate_prompt_provider: logical HIP 1, AMD Radeon Graphics, gfx1201, 32624 MiB

correctness.interpretation: The existing deterministic expert sentinel passed and live tokens matched. Full live logits were not promoted because the performance gate failed by 3.28x in the expert stage.

gfx1151_single_owner_control.topology: core, prompt experts, prompt join on gfx1151

gfx1201_synchronous_prompt_provider.topology: causal core on gfx1151; complete prompt expert provider and calibrated join on gfx1201; decode remains gfx1151

interpretation.measured: Storage and expert arithmetic are not the dominant regression. The candidate performs about 104.4 GB of macro-union weight H2D through 65,082 synchronous tensor-set calls, plus synchronous metadata sets. Those calls are outside the retained scatter and graph timers and leave 61.872 seconds unclassified.
interpretation.inference: The current synchronous delivery implementation can explain the regression through per-call and per-sync serialization. The negotiated PCIe 5.0 x16 link is not itself proven to be the limiting ceiling, so this run rejects only the synchronous provider implementation, not a batched asynchronous gfx1201 provider.
interpretation.next_action: Keep the experimental synchronous provider deleted. A future gfx1201 discriminator is earned only after replacing per-tensor synchronization with bounded same-stream asynchronous union uploads, using the existing pinned payload lifetime.

post_run_correction.reason: Source and counter audit separated actual macro-union H2D from P40/P45 subset counters and found 65,082 immediate stream synchronizations. The original raw-PCIe-ceiling wording was too strong.
post_run_correction.verdict_scope: NO-GO for the measured synchronous implementation only
